title: Benchmarks disagree on GPT-6 Astra, but its human-beating efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 pulls Chollet’s AGI forecast forward
summary: Epoch AI ranks GPT-6 Astra ahead with 169 points, while Artificial Analysis rates it no better than its predecessor and behind Claude Fable 5.1. On ARC-AGI-3, Astra achieves human-beating efficiency for the first time. François Chollet sees progress running twice as fast as expected and moves up his AGI forecast, though he does not call this proof of AGI.
